purpose: Take a user bug report for a built app from intake to a fix proved by a regression test and closed when a release contains it, or at merge for an app with no releases, with the lesson recorded so the same bug is not fixed twice.

Raw copy committed in the dev repo with SHA256SUMS.
Report fields filled and scrub check passed.
report_class is bug.
Owning repo resolved from the owner table.
No bug row matches, or a matching closed bug recurred in a version that holds its fix.
A bug row with the same app and error signature exists.
Report id added to the existing bug row and issue.
The report has an issue link or a one-word reason; if an issue was filed, a bug row now exists in state open.
Original moved to Bugs/_archive/<date>/ after sha256 match.
Bug row exists, unclaimed.
One open bug selected.
Claim file pushed for the bug's issue.
fleet pick answered run.
Budget gate allowed the lane.
Job file generated for the bug's current stage.
Bug row has no repro_test.
Repro job card outcome is passed.
Repro test fails on main with the reported signature; path stored in the bug row.
Fix job exists with the repro test locked and listed as fail-before.
Fix job card outcome is passed.
Regression check on the card shows failed on base, passes now.
A repro or fix attempt did not pass its checks.
Fewer than three attempts made and the last two attempts' diffs differ.
pitfalls.md entry for this bug is on the branch.
Bug class row exists; its signature list may be empty.
STATUS.md row written on the branch.
PR exists with Verified and Not verified lists.
Latest verdict on the head sha is PASS.
merge_pr.py check report written with exit 0.
Fix is on main; fix_sha stored.
Sibling repos searched for the class signatures; candidates filed.
A release contains fix_sha, or the app's owner_row.release_style is none (no releases: the bug closes at merge).
Issue closed with the closing record, after a release contains the fix, or at merge for an app with no releases.
Waiting on the owner; listed in Switchboard's Waiting on you.
Owner dropped the bug.
Scheduled scorer run is due.
Sampled runs have score rows.
Improver PR against this spec file is open.
Owner merged or closed the improver PR.

invariants.statement: A fix job exists only for a bug whose repro_test failed on main with the reported signature.
A fix PR is opened only when the card's regression check failed on base and passes on the branch.
The fix job's files_allowed excludes the repro test.
Every fix PR adds exactly one pitfalls line naming the bug id, class and test, within the 60-word cap, in the app's own repo.
No two open bug rows share a repo and normalised error signature.
Every app in a report manifest maps to exactly one owner_row.
An original leaves the inbox only when its raw copy is pushed with a matching sha256 and an issue link or reason exists.
No bug gets more than three attempts without the owner's ruling.
An issue is closed only when a release contains fix_sha, or at merge when the app's owner_row.release_style is none.
No merge without a PASS verdict on the head sha and green CI.
No model job starts unless fleet budget allow <lane> exits 0.
No issue, ledger row or pitfalls line holds a private word, name, path or address from a report.
Every new command prints JSON and exits 0, or exits 75 for not now; any other exit is an error.
A change to this spec reaches main only through a PR the owner merges.
Every step that needs the owner raises exactly one waiting_item in Waiting on you, and no step asks him anywhere else.
